title: Type Slot — one packed placement (absorbs PromoSlot / Babulus-4c7)
description:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress.

**This issue is the Slot spec.** It absorbs the parked PromoSlot epic (same id Babulus-4c7). Do not file a second Slot type.

## Type: Slot

One placement: when a packed item should go. Channel `linkedin` | `x` (not Discord). Timezone America/New_York. Links an Asset/Deliverable, optional Campaign, Creative, angle.

## Fields (design, not schema)

- **channel**: `linkedin` | `x` (not Discord)
- **when**: America/New_York
- **asset** / deliverable
- **campaign** (optional)
- **creative** / angle
- **share_payload** (the packed Buffer-style payload)

## States

`draft` → `ready` → `approved` → `queued` → `posted` | `skipped`

**Ryan must approve before queued.**

`queued` means **packed and waiting for the human click**, not that a bot posted. That click (SharePayload `handed_off`) is the only write to the network. Until a review UI exists, approved/queued is the finish line and a human pastes. Do not auto-post. LinkedIn / X / Google Ads / Meta connectors may stay out of scope.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> draft
  draft --> ready
  ready --> approved
  approved --> queued
  queued --> posted
  queued --> skipped
  posted --> [*]
  skipped --> [*]
```

## What changed from the original PromoSlot write-up

- Discord dropped as a promo channel
- Track is `hire` | `human` (not anthus/b0rd as the primary axis)
- Blurb/link live on Creative + SharePayload; Slot is the when/where
- Queued ≠ bot posted; queued = packed, awaiting human click (Buffer analog)
- Do not smash into MarketingInteraction
- Do not add a Papyrus newsroom promote stage
- Do not stand up a spreadsheet as source of truth

## Out of scope

- No model, UI, SES, LinkedIn, X, Google Ads, or Meta implementation from this issue
- Nothing posts live unless Ryan says so
